research_question.title: Can the first norm tensor be compiled with bounded exact TT ranks?

field_types: prime fields of characteristic greater than three
registered quadratic extensions used only to bind two coordinate residuals

research_question.motivation: The preceding zero-locator study left the first Hadamard norm product as its immediate open gate. A bounded-rank constructive norm representation would isolate Fermat powering, rather than coordinate equality, as the next obstruction and could supply a fixed-curve relation-compiler primitive.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether the componentwise norm h_Q of the exact five-source equality scalar has a degree-preserving polynomial representative, bounded exact TT cut ranks independent of registry size B, and an explicitly chargeable target-specialization route from fixed-curve source advice; then identify the first unresolved power stage without claiming a decomposition or ECDLP improvement.
constraints: All curves, registries, targets, mode order, addition tree, extension bases, and circuit gates are frozen before tensor evaluation.
Primary registries contain unique affine points; duplicate labels, planted targets, and the identity are controls only.
The literal polynomial p-th power is not used for the degree argument; conjugation is represented as e_X + omega^p e_Y on F_p-valued registered inputs.
Full B^5 enumeration is charged and interpreted only as a toy semantic diagnostic.
No exponent is fitted from B at or below the Hilbert saturation thresholds.
Offline operations, advice words and bytes, traffic, peak memory, online operations, target count, success probability, generator fixation, and curve structure are reported separately.
A bounded first-norm rank is not a witness locator, a relation generator, an index-calculus algorithm, or an ECDLP improvement.
